sections.title: Website operator
paragraphs: This website, www.bmygym.com, is operated by:

Bojana Pesic, trading as BMYGYM
Avda. Primado Reig 129, Entlo. D
46020 Valencia, Spain
Email: hello@bmygym.com

BMYGYM is an independent, founder-led business specialising in the creative direction, concept development and coordination of bespoke longevity and wellness environments for exceptional properties, private residences, luxury hospitality, superyachts and private aviation.

sections.title: Purpose of the website
paragraphs: The website provides information about BMYGYM, its design philosophy, services and conceptual projects.
The content is intended for general information and professional enquiries. It does not constitute a binding commercial offer, technical specification or contractual commitment.
All projects are developed individually according to client requirements, feasibility, applicable regulations and separately agreed contractual terms.

sections.title: Conceptual designs and visualisations
paragraphs: Images, renderings, architectural representations and product concepts displayed on this website are intended to communicate the creative vision and design direction of BMYGYM.
Some representations may be digitally generated or enhanced.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, they should not be interpreted as photographs of completed installations or evidence that a particular product has been manufactured, tested, certified or made commercially available.
Final designs, materials, specifications, functionality, manufacturing arrangements and regulatory approvals depend on the individual project.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Unless otherwise indicated, original content, creative concepts, designs, visual materials, branding and other protected elements displayed on this website belong to BMYGYM or are used with appropriate permission.
All rights are reserved.
Unauthorised reproduction, distribution, modification or commercial exploitation of protected materials is prohibited except where permitted by applicable law or expressly authorised in writing.
Third-party trademarks and materials remain the property of their respective owners.

sections.title: Professional enquiries and agreements
paragraphs: Submitting an enquiry through this website does not create a contractual relationship or an obligation for BMYGYM to accept a project.
All professional engagements, including the BMYGYM Private Longevity Blueprint, are subject to individually agreed terms, scope of work, fees and payment conditions.
Confidentiality obligations and intellectual property arrangements relating to individual projects may be established through separate written agreements.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: BMYGYM makes reasonable efforts to ensure that information published on this website is accurate and up to date.
However, website content may change as concepts, services and projects evolve.
BMYGYM is not responsible for decisions made solely on the basis of general website information.
Nothing in this notice excludes liability or statutory rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: External links
paragraphs: This website may contain links to third-party websites. BMYGYM does not control their content or privacy practices.

sections.title: Applicable law
paragraphs: This website is governed by applicable Spanish law and directly applicable European Union law.
Any disputes shall be subject to the competent courts determined under applicable law, including mandatory consumer protection rules where relevant.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Personal data submitted through www.bmygym.com is processed by:

Bojana Pesic, trading as BMYGYM
Avda. Primado Reig 129, Entlo. D
46020 Valencia, Spain
Email: hello@bmygym.com

BMYGYM respects the privacy of its website visitors, clients and professional partners and processes personal information in accordance with applicable data protection legislation, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: 2. Information collected
paragraphs: When visitors contact BMYGYM or submit a project enquiry, the following information may be collected:

The project enquiry form requires your full name, email address, client category, project type and message. Company and project location are optional. The selected website language and your acknowledgement of the Privacy Policy accompany the enquiry.

Name and email address.
Company or professional affiliation, where provided.
Client category and project type.
Project location and general project details.
Information voluntarily included in messages or correspondence.
Technical information necessary for website functionality and security.
Visitors are requested not to submit sensitive personal information through the general contact form.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of processing
paragraphs: Personal information is used to:

Respond to enquiries and requests for information.
Evaluate potential projects and professional collaborations.
Communicate with prospective and existing clients.
Prepare and manage professional engagements.
Maintain website security and functionality.
Fulfil applicable legal obligations.
Personal data submitted through the contact form is not automatically used for marketing subscriptions.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, personal data is processed on the basis of:

Taking steps at the request of an individual before entering into a contract.
Performance of an existing contract.
Compliance with applicable legal obligations.
Legitimate interests in responding to professional enquiries and maintaining website security.
Consent where legally required.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
paragraphs: Personal information may be processed by service providers supporting website hosting, technical maintenance, email communications and enquiry management.

When email delivery is configured, project enquiries are sent to BMYGYM through Resend, our email delivery provider. This website does not store enquiries in an application database. If the form is unavailable, visitors can contact hello@bmygym.com directly by email.
Such providers are permitted to process personal information only as necessary for their services and in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
BMYGYM does not sell personal information.
Personal data may also be disclosed where required by law.

sections.title: 6. International transfers
paragraphs: Where service providers process personal information outside the European Economic Area, appropriate safeguards will be applied as required by applicable data protection legislation.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
paragraphs: Personal information is retained only for as long as necessary to respond to enquiries, manage professional relationships, fulfil contractual obligations and comply with applicable legal requirements.
Information that is no longer necessary will be deleted or anonymised, unless continued retention is legally required or justified.

sections.title: 8. Data security
paragraphs: BMYGYM takes reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse or disclosure.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Under applicable data protection legislation, individuals may have the right to:

Access their personal information.
Request correction of inaccurate data.
Request deletion of personal information.
Request restriction of processing.
Object to certain processing activities.
Request data portability where applicable.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Requests may be sent to hello@bmygym.com.
Individuals may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Authority (AEPD): www.aepd.es.

sections.title: 10. Third-party websites
paragraphs: External websites linked from BMYGYM may have independent privacy policies.

sections.title: 11. Policy updates
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect changes in legal requirements, business activities or website functionality.

sections.title: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions:

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy explains how www.bmygym.com uses cookies and similar technologies.
The website is operated by Bojana Pesic, trading as BMYGYM.

sections.title: 2. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that websites may store on a visitor’s device to support functionality, security, preferences or other technical purposes.

sections.title: 3. Use of cookies
paragraphs: BMYGYM aims to use only those cookies and similar technologies necessary for the operation, security and functionality of its website, unless additional technologies are introduced and disclosed.

The current website does not set application cookies or use browser session storage. When the information notice is closed, it saves the closure date in browser local storage under bmygym.cookie-notice.v1 to remember that preference for 180 days. This technical record is not used for tracking or as consent to optional services. Language selection is reflected in the URL. Fonts and images are served by the website itself.
Strictly necessary technologies may be used without prior consent where permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: 4. Analytics and advertising
paragraphs: The current website does not load analytics, advertising services, tracking pixels, embedded social widgets or other optional tracking technologies. BMYGYM does not use cookies for behavioural advertising or cross-site advertising tracking.

If optional analytics, marketing or other consent-based technologies are introduced, the Cookie Policy will be updated and appropriate consent controls will be provided before such technologies are activated.

sections.title: 5. Third-party technologies
paragraphs: Website hosting, security, embedded content or other technical services may use cookies or similar technologies.
Where applicable, their purposes and relevant information will be disclosed in accordance with legal requirements.

sections.title: 6. Cookie preferences
paragraphs: Visitors may manage or delete cookies and local website storage through their browser settings.

There are currently no optional cookies to accept or reject. Cookie Settings in the footer reopens the information notice and its link to this policy. Closing the notice only remembers its dismissal; it does not provide consent to analytics, advertising or other optional services.
Where optional cookies requiring consent are used, visitors will be provided with an appropriate means of accepting, rejecting or managing those cookies.
The notice appears again after 180 days, if local website storage is deleted or if the notice version changes. If the browser blocks local storage, the preference cannot be remembered.

sections.title: 7. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: BMYGYM may update this Cookie Policy when website technologies or legal requirements change.

sections.title: 8. Contact
paragraphs: For questions regarding cookies:
hello@bmygym.com

sections.title: 1. Our commitment
paragraphs: BMYGYM is committed to providing a clear, inclusive and accessible online experience for all visitors, clients and professional partners.
We aim to make www.bmygym.com easy to navigate, understand and use across different devices and browsing environments.

sections.title: 2. Accessibility approach
paragraphs: In developing and maintaining the website, BMYGYM aims to support:

Clear and readable typography.
Consistent navigation and page structure.
Responsive layouts for desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
Meaningful headings and descriptive content.
Appropriate text alternatives for informative images.
Accessible contact forms and interactive elements.
Sufficient visual contrast and legibility.
Keyboard navigation where technically supported.
We use recognised web accessibility principles, including the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), as a reference for ongoing improvements.

sections.title: 3. Current status
paragraphs: BMYGYM continues to review and improve the accessibility of its website.
Some content or features may not yet fully meet every accessibility recommendation.
This statement does not constitute formal accessibility certification.

sections.title: 4. Feedback and assistance
paragraphs: If you experience difficulties accessing information, navigating the website or submitting a project enquiry, please contact us.
We welcome feedback and will make reasonable efforts to provide information through an alternative accessible method where possible.

sections.title: 5. Contact
paragraphs:
BMYGYM – Bojana Pesic
Email: hello@bmygym.com

sections.title: 6. Updates
paragraphs: This statement may be updated as website functionality and accessibility improvements evolve.
